lanes.summary: The diff fully implements PMAT-3090 without executing repository tests or background tasks. It updates QHF-GPU-008 with a 1e-3 relative L-infinity tolerance against an exact f32 reference for GDN and attention ops. It adds QHF-GPU-009 which performs end-to-end verification against the production CPU, enforcing an identical argmax and a cosine similarity floor of 0.996, and critically omits the tolerance field for this new invariant. Furthermore, FALSIFY-QHF-009 is introduced to execute on each required host and process receipts as explicitly demanded by the ticket. No code was altered, matching the ticket's specifications.

findings.claim: QHF-GPU-008 property and formal specify 1e-3 relative tolerance against an exact f32 reference for both GDN and attention ops
QHF-GPU-009 defines end-to-end production CPU checks with identical argmax and cosine >= 0.996, without carrying a tolerance field
FALSIFY-QHF-009 runs tests on EACH required host and verifies through model_ladder.sh and check_model_ladder.sh receipts
